subject: general
question: Who among the following is appointed as the chairman of the 16th Finance Commission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arvind Panagariya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Arvind Panagariya is an Indian economist and former Vice Chairman of the **NITI Aayog**, a policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• He is a professor of Economics and the Jagdish Bhagwati Professor of Indian Political Economy at **Columbia University**.
 
• Arvind Panagariya has been appointed as the chairman of the **16th Finance Commission**, tasked with recommending the distribution of tax revenues between the Union and State Governments.
 
• His appointment is significant due to his extensive experience in economic policy formulation and development strategies.
 
• Panagariya has authored several books and research papers on Indian economic reforms and trade policies, making him a leading authority in the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Finance Commission:**

 
 
• The Finance Commission is a constitutional body created under **Article 280** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is established every five years to make recommendations on the distribution of tax revenues between the Union and the States.
 
• The Commission also advises on measures to improve fiscal health and financial stability across the country.
 
 
 
• **Responsibilities of the Finance Commission:**
 
 
• Determining the sharing of central taxes between the Union and States.
 
• Providing recommendations on grants-in-aid to States by the Union.
 
• Advising measures to improve revenue generation and fiscal discipline for both Union and States.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog:**
 
 
• NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015 as the apex policy think tank of the Indian government.
 
• It focuses on fostering cooperative federalism and designing strategic long-term policies for India.
 
• Arvind Panagariya served as the first Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog from January 2015 to August 2017.
 
 
 
• **Tax Revenue Distribution:**
 
 
• The Finance Commission assesses the financial position of states and determines the formula for tax distribution.
 
• Its recommendations ensure equitable financial allocation to address developmental disparities across states.
